about: Agent eval set (docs/agentic-rag-improvements.md, item 1). `kb` names the knowledge base the question runs against (docs/, code/, or both = mixed). `first` lists the acceptable first actions. `facts` are case-insensitive regexes the answer must all match; for a question the knowledge base can't answer, the fact is that the answer says so.
